identity.notes: Large guard-gated master-planned community in Weston, FL 33332. Not a single HOA — consists of multiple independent maintenance associations (W.H. Maintenance, Hills Maintenance, North Hills Maintenance) all managed by Castle Group. The master W.H. Maintenance Association oversees main thoroughfares, gates, monuments, landscaping, and four community parks, while sub-associations handle their specific districts. Features 24-hour security, lakes, and trails. The private Club at Weston Hills (separate membership) offers two Robert Trent Jones Jr. golf courses, clubhouse, tennis, fitness, and pools.

fees.note: Lower end of range for single-family homes; covers common area maintenance and security. Fees vary significantly by sub-association and property type. Condo/townhome fees can reach ~$885/mo including building insurance. Exact current fees, transfer fees, capital contributions, and special assessments unavailable publicly; contact Castle Group: (954) 792-6000, Rnunez@castlegroup.com. Governed by FL Statute Ch. 720. No special assessment signals reported yet.

Upper end of resident-verified observed range ($130-$867/mo). Single-family typically $130-$500/mo; condos/townhomes higher (~$885/mo in some cases) including building insurance and structural maintenance. Not a guaranteed fee; verify with association directly.
